name: macOS
title: Private browsing, at home or on the move.
lead: Bring Traverse VPN to your Mac for an encrypted connection, simple server choices, and a familiar one-tap setup.
description: A VPN for Mac encrypts the connection between your Mac and a VPN server. It can help keep traffic more private on café, hotel, and airport Wi-Fi while masking your regular network IP from the websites you visit.
imageAlt: Mac style laptop on a travel desk

highlights.title: A simple setup
highlights.text: Install the macOS app, sign in, and connect without manually building a VPN profile.

highlights.title: Safer shared networks
highlights.text: Add an encrypted layer when using Wi-Fi away from home or the office.

highlights.title: Protection that fits
highlights.text: Use server selection and available connection settings to suit your everyday workflow.

detailsTitle: A familiar VPN experience on Mac

details.title: Encrypted traffic
details.text: Protect your connection with modern VPN encryption on the networks you use.

details.title: One tap to connect
